stem: A random variable $X$ has probability density function f. The graph of $\text{f}(x)$ is a straight line segment parallel to the $x$-axis from $x = 0$ to $x = a$, where $a$ is a positive constant.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State, in terms of $a$, the median of $X$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Given that $\text{P}(X < b) = p$, where $0 < b < \frac{1}{2}a$, find $\text{P}\left(\frac{1}{3}b < X < a - \frac{1}{3}b\right)$ in terms of $p$.
